subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally shorten home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and changing it affects UX, privacy, docs, tests, and possible config surface.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display by default while continuing to fix corrupted or non-copyable path rewrites.

options.title: Switch Default To Full Paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full absolute paths everywhere and update shared helpers, prompts, docs, and regression tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep compact display by default but add a documented opt-in mode for users who need full absolute paths, with tests for both modes.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display by default while continuing to fix corrupted or non-copyable path rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: The central display helper history and recent adjacent path-display work make this the best available routing owner for the product contract choice.
